Kaggle's pet's facial expression dataset with EfficientNetB5 CNN.

A tiny web app that classify a pet's emotions fro a photo.
Upload an image, get the predicted emotion + confidence.

End-to-end pipeline:
1. Training model
2. Wrap it in web interface
3. Deploy

The model is EfficientNetB5 CNN, transfer learning on balanced dataset. Gradio App on Hugging Face Space (free CPU tier).

[Full code here](https://github.com/nikozhuk/face-classification).
